text: {"label":"Communication and Technology Supports in Disabilities","definition":"Work on augmentative and alternative communication, mobile and portable technology, and prompting strategies that build communication, social interaction, and independence for people with developmental, intellectual, or multiple disabilities.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on communication systems and assistive technology rather than challenging behavior assessment (43), school-based academic instruction (117), or sign language and braille for sensory impairments (65)."}
